picks.name: Nikki Nair
picks.source_note: New artist discovery on Hyperdub. Bass/club-adjacent territory connected to your Loraine James and Actress picks.
picks.bio: "Majestic Animals" (October 16, 2026, Hyperdub) is Nikki Nair's first solo EP for the label -- four tracks ("Groundhogs," "Tapir Spectrum," "Primate Indicator," "Walrus2") each named for an animal, following his 2025 collaborative record "Nagoya" with Foodman on the same label.
picks.why_listen: Springy, drum-forward club tracks with a playful, left-field edge -- fresh out today and built for a set that wants texture without losing momentum.

picks.name: Dorisburg
picks.source_note: Dorisburg already in your library (Nous'klaer Audio roster). New EP on Kalawila's Mountain Explosion Device label.
picks.bio: "Venom" (October 16, 2026, Mountain Explosion Device) is a two-track EP from Dorisburg (Alexander Berg) -- the title track and "Serum" -- his first release of the year and the third release on Kalawila's Stockholm label.
picks.why_listen: A fresh, mind-bending cut from a producer already in your library -- sharp, texture-driven techno straight off today's release date.
